source_frontier.finding: The recovery branch contained no material R07 recovery commits beyond the registered PACK frontier. R07-FINAL therefore completed the persisted recovery contract from exact durable authority/source artifacts and did not reconstruct inaccessible historical chats.

summary: V26 remains the registered stable Class Player rollback donor; its positive-rollback scope must not be inflated into whole-product Human Acceptance.

V37 remains a candidate descendant and the registered best-known donor for laser transform tracking; source inspection also proves multi-board/object semantics and richer typed undo as candidate gains.
Psicoanálisis PageKit remains a distinct consumer integration surface with a global annotation layer and multi-sheet whiteboard; it is not Class Player or shared whiteboard authority.
Pressed-only eraser behavior is evidenced across V26, V37 and Psico and is preserved as a regression guard.
V26 and Psico have simple last-stroke undo paths; V37 has typed reversible actions for stroke erase/clear plus object operations.
Generic Pointer Events are evidenced, but Wacom pressure/button support is not. No application Fullscreen API implementation is evidenced in the inspected artifacts.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog, Lineage or capability-registry promotion was performed.

cross_workstream.reason: Agent Network owns coordination/network/** and DELTA_FEED is read-only for R07 after scope reconciliation. The runtime-mandated independent worker status carries the useful impact without recreating the write collision.
cross_workstream.action: Future Class/Study/PageKit integration should treat V26 as the stability rollback donor and V37 as a selective capability donor, preserve pressed-only eraser behavior and typed undo when adopting object/erase semantics, keep Psico sheet semantics separate, and never claim Wacom pressure/buttons or application fullscreen without actual implementation and validation.

closure.meaning: The R07 recovery worker has no remaining repository-only recovery work. Its evidence is ready for consumption by the existing PageKit/Class Player/Classes/Study owners without transferring product authority to R07.
